terms_privacy_description: How {siteName} works, and what it keeps about you.
terms_privacy_use_unofficial: {siteName} is a fan-made tool. It isn't run by or affiliated with Modhaus or Cosmo.
terms_privacy_use_conduct: Don't scam, harass, spam or pretend to be someone else. Anyone can report a user who does.
terms_privacy_use_moderation: Moderators review reports. They can warn an account, mute it in chat, block it from trading or ban it.
terms_privacy_use_trades: Trades are between you and the other collector. {siteName} can't guarantee a trade or get objekts back.
terms_privacy_data_sign_in: Signing in with Discord or X gives us your name, username and picture, plus your email address from Discord. We never post for you.
terms_privacy_data_stored: We keep what you make here: lists, pins, linked Cosmo profiles, trades, messages and settings. Each sign-in records your IP address and browser, to keep your sessions secure.
terms_privacy_data_public: Collections and transfers shown here come from the public blockchain, not from your account.
terms_privacy_data_chat: Messages are checked for common scam signs, like asking someone to send first or pay through PayPal. A match shows a caution in the chat and is noted for moderators.
terms_privacy_data_reports: Moderators can't read your messages. They see a conversation only when someone reports it and chooses to share it, and that copy includes messages you unsent.
terms_privacy_data_email: We email you only to verify your address, reset your password or confirm deleting your account.
terms_privacy_data_no_sell: We don't sell or share your data.
terms_privacy_data_delete: You can delete your account in {#link}account settings{/link}. That removes the account and the data tied to it.
terms_privacy_points_open_source: {siteName} is open source. {#link}See the code on GitHub{/link}.

mod_excerpt_profile: Reported from a profile, with no messages.
mod_staff_target: This account is staff. Only an admin can act on it.
mod_admin_target: This account is an admin, so it can't be sanctioned. You can still dismiss its reports.
mod_act_reason_placeholder: e.g. Asked several traders to send first
mod_act_reason_hint: Required. The user sees it with the action.
mod_act_reason_required: Write a reason. The user sees it.
mod_act_error: Couldn't apply the action. Try again.
mod_error_self: You can't act on your own account.
mod_error_daily_limit: You've done this too many times recently. Please try again later.
mod_action_dismiss_hint: Closes the open reports with no sanction.
mod_action_warn_hint: Sends the user a warning in their bell.
mod_action_chat_mute_hint: They can't start conversations or send messages until it ends.
mod_action_trade_block_hint: Their lists leave Market, Trade and alerts for everyone until revoked.
mod_action_ban_hint: Signs them out everywhere and refuses sign-in until the ban ends or is revoked.
mod_revoke_description: The sanction ends now. The reason goes to the audit log.
mod_role_is_user: This account has no staff role.
mod_act_success_none: Done. There were no open reports.
mod_caution_both: This message asks you to send first and pay outside the site, which scams often do.
mod_revoke_not_active: This sanction has already ended or been revoked.
mod_address_description: Every account that linked this Cosmo address, newest first.
mod_address_unheld: Not linked to any account now
mod_address_none: Nothing is recorded for this address.
mod_move_description: The address links to the account you enter at once, with no wait. Its lists stay with this account. The reason goes to both audit logs.
mod_move_target_hint: The id in the account's console link.
mod_move_target_required: Enter the account to move it to.
mod_unlink_address_description: The address leaves the account. For 7 days only that account can link it again. The reason goes to the audit log.
mod_address_sanctioned: One of the accounts has an active trade block or ban.
mod_address_in_trade: The address is in a trade in progress.
mod_address_changed: The address is no longer linked to this account. Reload and check.
mod_deleted_target: This account was deleted. Only Dismiss is available.
mod_move_deleted_target: The receiving account was deleted, so the address can't move to it.
mod_role_grant_desc: They can open the moderator console, read shared messages, and apply or revoke sanctions. The audit log records the change.
mod_role_remove_desc: They lose the moderator console on their next load. The audit log records the change.
offer_mine_empty_hint: Make an offer from a Trade post, a Trade match or a conversation.
offer_builder_description: Both sides are checked against current on-chain ownership.
offer_note_placeholder: e.g. Can send tonight after 9pm KST
notification_pref_offer_desc: When an offer to or from you is sent, answered or cancelled.
offer_builder_empty_hint: Add at least one objekt to either side.
offer_builder_blocked_hint: Remove the objekts that can't be offered.
offer_builder_note_hint: Shorten the note to send the offer.
offer_matches_added: Added {give} you give and {get} you get from your matches
offer_matches_added_give: Added {count} you give from your matches
offer_matches_added_give_one: Added 1 you give from your match
offer_matches_added_get: Added {count} you get from your matches
offer_matches_added_get_one: Added 1 you get from your match
offer_matches_added_post: Added from {list}: {give} you give and {get} you get
offer_matches_capped_give: Only {max} of the {count} that matched fit on You give.
offer_matches_capped_get: Only {max} of the {count} that matched fit on You get.
offer_matches_failed: Couldn't add your matches. Add objekts below.
offer_near_unavailable: The objekt you picked couldn't be added: no copy of it can be offered right now, or that side is full.
offer_discard_desc: What you've added so far will be lost.
offer_cancel_reserved: an objekt in it was traded
offer_cancel_token_moved: an objekt in it left its wallet
offer_cancel_not_transferable: an objekt in it can no longer be transferred
offer_cancel_sanction: an account in it can't trade right now
offer_cancel_account_deleted: an account in it was deleted
offer_cancel_party: the other side cancelled the trade
offer_leg_away: Left the giver's wallet. Back or delivered by {date}, or the trade ends
offer_picker_full: This side is full. Remove one to pick another.
offer_picker_mine_desc: Objekts held by your linked Cosmo profiles. Your have lists come first.
offer_picker_theirs_desc: Entries on {name}'s have and sale lists that you can see, checked against what they own now.
offer_picker_mine_none_wanted: You hold nothing on {name}'s want lists
offer_picker_theirs_none_wanted: {name} holds nothing on your want lists
offer_picker_theirs_none_listed_hint: You can still offer your objekts, or ask in chat.
offer_picker_theirs_none_held_hint: What they listed has been traded away or can't be transferred.
offer_picker_theirs_collection_desc: Objekts {name} holds now, at profiles they show. {name} has no have or sale list on Trade, so you can ask for anything here.
offer_picker_theirs_collection_empty: {name} holds nothing you can ask for
offer_picker_list_empty: You hold none of this list's objekts
offer_picker_theirs_list_empty: Nothing on this list is available
offer_refused_invalid_topup: Check the top-up: a positive amount with at most 2 decimals, in a listed currency.
offer_refused_not_allowed: You can't do that with this offer.
offer_refused_not_listed: Something under You get isn't on a list you can offer for anymore.
offer_refused_not_open: This offer has already been answered.
offer_refused_not_owned: No longer held by its owner: {objekts}
offer_refused_reserved: Already in a trade in progress: {objekts}
offer_refused_too_many: At most {max} objekts on each side.
offer_refused_too_many_open: You have too many open offers. Withdraw one first.
offer_refused_trade_blocked: Your account can't trade right now.
offer_send_error: Couldn't send the offer. Try again.
offer_side_give_empty: Nothing yet. Leave it empty to buy with money alone.
offer_side_get_empty: Nothing yet. Leave it empty to sell or give.
offer_topup_you_pay: + {amount} paid by you · paid outside, not verified
offer_topup_they_pay: + {amount} paid by them · paid outside, not verified
offer_topup_unverified: Paid outside Objekt Tracker, not verified. We can check objekt transfers, never payments.
offer_trade_cancel_desc: {name} is notified, and the objekts in it are free to offer again.
trust_unfinished_hint: Failed trades where they didn't send their part
notification_offer_updated: Your offer with {partner} has an update
notification_pref_trade_desc: When a transfer in your trade is verified, the trade ends, or a transfer is overdue.
notification_trade_updated: Your trade with {partner} has an update
notification_trade_cancelled_moved: Your trade with {partner} was cancelled: an objekt left the wallet
notification_trade_cancelled_not_transfe: Your trade with {partner} was cancelled: an objekt can no longer be transferred
notification_trade_failed: Your trade with {partner} failed. You can report a problem
notification_trade_cancelled_expired: Your trade with {partner} was cancelled: no transfer within {days} days
notification_trade_failed_expired: Your trade with {partner} ended unfinished after {days} days. You can report a problem
notification_trade_stuck: An objekt in your trade with {partner} can't be sent right now. The trade stays open
notification_trade_away: An objekt in your trade with {partner} left the giver's wallet. The trade ends unless it's back or delivered by {date}
notification_trade_away_yours: Your {serial} in your trade with {partner} left your wallet. Bring it back or send it by {date}, or the trade ends
notification_trade_away_theirs: {partner}'s {serial} left their wallet. The trade ends unless it's back or delivered by {date}
notification_trade_wrong_copy: In your trade with {partner}, {sent} was sent where the trade asks for {asked}
notification_trade_wrong_copy_until: In your trade with {partner}, {sent} was sent where the trade asks for {asked}. It counts as accepted on {date} unless declined
notification_trade_wrong_copy_due: In your trade with {partner}, {sent} counts as accepted in place of {asked} on {date} unless you decline
notification_trade_wrong_copy_due_soon: In your trade with {partner}, {sent} counts as accepted in place of {asked} soon unless you decline
notification_trade_wrong_copy_auto_accep: In your trade with {partner}, {sent} was accepted in place of {asked}
offer_cancel_locked: Cancelling is locked after the first verified transfer
offer_stall_body: If a transfer is still waiting after 72 hours, whoever owes it gets a reminder. A different copy that isn't declined counts as accepted 72 hours after it arrives. After 7 days, Report a problem opens a report with this trade attached. After 14 days, an unfinished trade ends: failed if a transfer was verified or a different copy was declined, otherwise cancelled.
offer_first_you_sent: You did, so it's their turn.
offer_first_hint: The side with more unfinished trades sends first, then the one with fewer verified trades, then the newer account. It's a suggestion: nothing stops either of you.
offer_serial_estimated_note: ~ marks a serial we estimated. Cosmo may show a different number, so check the objekt in Cosmo before you send it.
offer_wrong_copy_you_sent: You sent {sent}, this trade asks for {asked}
offer_wrong_copy_giver_hint: {name} can accept it, or you can send {asked}.
offer_wrong_copy_accept_desc: This transfer verifies the leg, as if the trade had asked for this copy. You can't undo it.
offer_wrong_copy_accept_by: Counts as accepted on {date} unless you decline.
offer_wrong_copy_accept_by_giver: Counts as accepted on {date} unless {name} declines.
offer_refused_not_receiver: Only the person who received a wrong copy can accept or decline it.
offer_refused_substitute_closed: This copy can't be accepted or declined anymore: the leg or the trade has moved on.
offer_refused_substitute_taken: That transfer already verified a leg in another trade.
offer_refused_leg_closed: This objekt can't be marked as received anymore: it was verified, or the trade has moved on.
offer_refused_copy_pending: Accept or decline the different copy first, then mark it as received.
offer_refused_confirmed_trade: A trade with an objekt marked as received can't be rated.
offer_mark_received_desc: Do this only if you got it some other way, such as at a profile you haven't linked or a friend's. It closes for good, and this trade won't count toward verified trades or take ratings once it completes.
offer_next_completed_confirmed: An objekt was marked as received, so this trade won't count toward verified trades and can't be rated.
offer_away_hint: Did it go to a Cosmo profile of yours that isn't linked here? Link it by {date} and it counts.
offer_indexer_behind: We're behind on reading the chain. Transfers after {time} aren't seen yet. Nothing you sent is lost: it shows up here once we catch up.
offer_indexer_behind_unknown: We're behind on reading the chain, so recent transfers aren't seen yet. Nothing you sent is lost: it shows up here once we catch up.
offer_refused_indexer_behind: We can't see the latest transfers yet. Try again in a few minutes.
offer_rating_title_failed: Rate {name}: they didn't send their part
offer_rating_closed: Feedback for this trade has closed.
offer_rating_private: Only totals are shown; nobody sees a single rating.
offer_rating_error: Couldn't save your rating. Try again.
offer_rating_saved: Saved. You can change it anytime.
offer_refused_not_completed: Only a completed trade can be rated.
offer_refused_rating_closed: Feedback for this trade has closed.
offer_refused_links_changed: A linked Cosmo ID changed while this offer was being accepted. Try again.
offer_report_attached: Trade {trade} goes with the report: its objekts, transfers and transaction hashes.
offer_next_suggestion: It's a suggestion: nothing stops either of you.
offer_next_send_body: It shows as verified here a few minutes after you send it.
offer_next_their_turn: Waiting for {name} to send their part
offer_next_nothing_to_do: Nothing to do on your side.
offer_next_stuck: Your {objekt} can't be sent right now
offer_next_stuck_body: It reads as non-transferable. The trade waits, and ends as failed on {date} if it still hasn't arrived.
offer_next_away: Your {objekt} left your wallet. Bring it back or send it by {date}, or the trade ends.
offer_next_their_away: {name}'s {objekt} left their wallet. The trade ends unless it's back or delivered by {date}.
offer_next_completed: Trade complete. How did it go?
offer_clock_ends_completed: Ends as completed if still unfinished: the wrong copies you hold are accepted
offer_clock_ends_failed: Ends as failed if still unfinished
offer_clock_ends_cancelled: Ends as cancelled if still unfinished
offer_trade_cancelled_moved: An objekt left the wallet before any transfer was verified.
offer_trade_cancelled_not_transferable: An objekt can no longer be transferred, and nothing had been sent yet.
offer_trade_failed_desc: An objekt went to someone else after a transfer was verified. You can report a problem.
offer_trade_cancelled_expired: No transfer was verified within {days} days.
offer_trade_failed_expired_desc: Not every transfer was verified within {days} days. You can report a problem.
offer_refused_remove_hint: Remove it from the offer, then send again.
offer_not_available: This offer or trade isn't available anymore
account_page_description: Your account, Cosmo profiles and who can reach you.
trade_browse_no_mutual_list_title: No one can swap with you for {list}
trade_browse_no_mutual_title: No one can swap with you
trade_browse_no_mutual_hint: Nobody on Trade can swap with you right now.
chat_send_offline: You're offline. Your message wasn't sent.
chat_partner_deleted: This account was deleted. You can still read your earlier messages.
chat_refused_settings_limit: You're changing this too fast. Try again {time}.
trade_composer_kind_prompt: What do you want to do?
trade_composer_lists_prompt: Pick the lists for this post. A list can be in one post at a time.
trade_kind_swap_desc: Trade your objekts for ones you want. Pick what you offer, what you look for, or both.
trade_kind_sell_desc: Sell objekts for a price. Buyers and people who would pay find it.
trade_kind_buy_desc: Pay for objekts you're looking for. Sellers find it.
trade_composer_none_of_type: You have no lists of this type yet.
trade_composer_sale_note: Also listed on Market, with your prices.
trade_composer_also_pay: I'd also pay for what I'm looking for
trade_composer_also_pay_hint: Sellers with what you look for will see you as a match.
trade_composer_match_have: Matches people looking for what you offer.
trade_composer_match_want: Matches people offering what you look for.
trade_composer_match_both: Matches people looking for what you offer, and people offering what you look for. When both ways match, they show under Can swap.
trade_composer_match_also_pay: Also shows under WTB, so sellers with what you look for find you.
trade_composer_match_sell: Matches WTB posts, and WTT posts that would also pay.
trade_composer_match_buy: Matches WTS posts with what you look for. No swaps.
trade_composer_needs_profile: Not bound to a Cosmo profile, so it can't go on Trade.
trade_composer_unpair_buy: This list is paired with {name} for swaps. A Buy post doesn't swap, so posting it here unpairs them.
trade_composer_unpair_swap: This list is paired with {name}. Posting it with another list unpairs them.
trade_composer_unpaired: {name} will be unpaired when you post.
trade_composer_error: Couldn't save this post. Try again.
trade_my_posts_empty_title: You have no posts on Trade
trade_my_posts_empty_hint: Post a list to swap, sell or buy. Others find it in Browse and in their matches.
trade_take_off_error: Couldn't take this post off Trade. Try again.
trade_post_copy_link_idle: Bump it first: idle posts don't show in Browse.
trade_post_copy_link_blocked: Your account has a trade block, which hides your posts from Trade.
trade_line_not_on_hint: Post it so others find it in Browse and in their matches.
trade_line_paired_off_sell_hint: Posting it again brings back the same Sell post.
trade_line_not_on_sale_hint: Post it to show it on Market, in Browse and in others' matches.
trade_line_paired_off_hint: Posting it again brings back the same Swap post.
trade_line_needs_profile: Can't go on Trade: it isn't bound to a Cosmo profile. Copy it as a new list bound to your profile to post it.
list_created_post_hint: Post it on Trade so others find it in Browse and in their matches.
trade_help_tags_note: A Swap that also pays shows WTT and WTB; a Sell open to swaps shows WTS and WTT.
api_errors_trade_post_list_in_post: That list is already in another post on Trade.
api_errors_trade_post_list_paired: That list is paired with another list. Unpair them to use it here.
api_errors_trade_post_needs_profile: Have and sale lists need a Cosmo profile to go on Trade.
api_errors_trade_post_wrong_type: That list can't be used for this kind of post.
api_errors_trade_post_empty: Pick a list for this post.
offer_selected_send: You owe this one. Send it in the Cosmo app.
offer_selected_copy_they: {name} sent {sent} instead. Accept or decline it.
offer_sent_hint_accept: Both sides are already delivered. Press Accept to record the trade.
offer_sent_hint_wait: Both sides are already delivered. The trade is recorded once {name} accepts.
rule_add_desc: To {list}. Exact objekts are still added from Objekts, Collection or Progress.
rule_kind_collection_example: e.g. any CC366: Lynn CC366, Nien CC366 …
rule_kind_set_desc: Every collection of a class, for the members you pick.
rule_kind_set_example: e.g. Cream02 FCO 3rd: 117Z to 120Z, every member
rule_prio_desc: Shown beside the rule. Every member still matches.
rule_skip_owned_desc: Same as "any I don't have" on Discord.
rule_incomplete: Pick a season and a three-digit collection number.
rule_nothing_to_match: You own every objekt this rule describes, so it has nothing to match. Turn off Skip ones I own to look for spares anyway.
rule_detach_error: Couldn't turn the rule into objekts
rule_faded_note: Faded = you own it, so the rule skips it.
rule_faded_note_theirs: Faded = they own it, so the rule skips it.
rule_detach_desc: {rule} is replaced by the {count} objekts it matches now. They stay on the list as objekts and no longer follow what you own.
rule_detach_desc_one: {rule} is replaced by the 1 objekt it matches now. It stays on the list as an objekt and no longer follows what you own.
rule_delete_desc: {rule} and the objekts it wants leave the list. Objekts you added yourself stay.
api_errors_list_rule_nothing_to_match: You own everything this rule describes. Turn off Skip ones I own to keep it.
api_errors_list_rule_limit: A list holds up to 20 rules
rule_no_collections: No collection matches this rule. Check the season and collection number.
trade_help_rules: A rule on a want list counts like the objekts it covers, and each collection counts once. On a post it shows as one RULE tile with how many of yours it takes.
trade_help_near: It would match, but it counts only if you sell, swap or buy, as the line beside it says. It never counts toward a list's count, the row or Can swap.
trade_composer_also_swap_hint: People with what you want can offer a swap. Pick a want list to say what you'd swap for.
trade_composer_also_swap_off_hint: Tick to take swaps too; then you can add a want list.
trade_composer_match_sell_swap: WTT posts looking for these match it too.
trade_composer_unpair_sell: This list is paired with {name} for swaps. A Sell post without swaps doesn't keep the pair, so posting it unpairs them.
api_errors_list_sale_links_sell_only: Only a sale list open to swaps can be linked to a want list
trade_help_sale_swap_pair: Sale list open to swaps ↔ the want list linked to it, open to swaps
trade_help_cross_post: Have and want lists on different posts, or not linked
trade_help_post: A have or sale list and the want list linked to it. A swap uses one of your posts, and one of theirs.
